sql: select pt.strategy as arm, count(*) filter (where pt.status in ('settled','closed_sl')) as settled_trades, count(distinct pt.closed_at::date) filter (where pt.status in ('settled','closed_sl')) as settled_days, count(*) as all_trades, min(pt.created_at)::date as first_entry, max(pt.closed_at)::date as last_settle, round(sum(pt.pnl) filter (where pt.status in ('settled','closed_sl'))::numeric,2) as pnl from paper_trades pt where pt.strategy in ('Gmmsell0','Gmmsell1') group by 1 order by 1
purpose: how far Gmmsell0/Gmmsell1 are from the 60-settled-day gate floor
